{{Top|leg}}
A '''safe''' was a reinforced secure storage container that was made of metal and equipped with a lock. They were used for protecting [[Currency/Legends|money]] and valuables from theft.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] kept one in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to secure his valuables.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]], [[Glovstoak]] had a concealed walk-in safe in his private quarters. In it he kept [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] containing administration records and expensive pieces of artwork.<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
